question.text: Channels for retail investment include ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: A co-operative chit fund with no regulatory oversight

explanation.text: The Logic: Unregulated chit funds are not a legitimate investment channel. The Trap: Direct, MFs, PMS are mainstream channels. Cross-Exam Context: Same in X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Warn clients against unregulated schemes — report suspicious ones to SEBI/RBI.
